fato_historico: 1918: The Montenegrin Podgorica Assembly votes for a "union of the people", declaring assimilation into the Kingdom of Serbia.
energia_do_dia: The cosmic currents suggest a day for building bridges and finding unity within your personal goals. Just as history reflects a powerful movement toward collective harmony, you may find that your own ambitions align beautifully with those around you. It is a good time to consider how your dedication can create a lasting sense of belonging and support.
frase_do_dia: Strength is found when we choose to grow together in harmony.
significado_numero: Represents the balance between your professional goals and inner emotional peace.
conselho: Nurture your connections; collaboration often leads to your most prosperous outcomes.
